Jensen Huang was ousted as the Nvidia CEO following revelations and his admission that he had an affair with Alice Huang, a woman who US believes, was spying for China.
Episode 1935 details the cast of characters, and the ten questions these developments as well as the story raise. ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta also explains the complexities, and the web of companies, transactions, which are under scanner.
